raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Adds support for `response_format="srt"` and `response_format="vtt"` on the `/v1/audio/transcriptions` and `/v1/audio/translations` endpoints, matching the OpenAI audio API surface. Part of the Whisper feature tracker #25750 (the `response_formats` sub-item: `verbose_json` landed in #24209; this covers the remaining subtitle formats).

## Claims

- `srt` and `vtt` were already part of the documented `AudioResponseFormat` type alias and the `response_format` docstrings, but the serving layer rejected them at validation time. They are now accepted and served.
- Subtitle tracks are rendered from the same timestamped segments used by `verbose_json`: same `supports_segment_timestamp` requirement, same non-streamable constraint.
- The API routers now return a `PlainTextResponse` for `text`, `srt` and `vtt` (previously even `text` was wrapped in a JSON body). This also covers the fix proposed in #49102.

## Validation

- New unit tests in `tests/entrypoints/speech_to_text/test_subtitle_formats.py`: exact SRT/VTT cue rendering, timestamp hour rollover and millisecond formatting, blank-segment skipping and SRT renumbering, empty input, zero-length segments.
- Existing speech-to-text unit tests pass locally with the change (`test_speech_to_text_cancellation.py`, `test_chunk_timestamp_offset.py`, `test_transcription_inter_chunk_spacing.py`): 30 passed total including the new tests.
- `ruff check` and `ruff format` clean on all touched files.
- E2E endpoint tests that need a running server are left to CI.

## Details

- `base/utils.py`: new `format_segments_as_srt` / `format_segments_as_vtt` render a sequence of timestamped segments (structural `SubtitleSegment` protocol, so both `TranscriptionSegment` and `TranslationSegment` fit) into standard subtitle tracks: numbered cues with `HH:MM:SS,mmm` timestamps for SRT; a `WEBVTT` header with `HH:MM:SS.mmm` cues for VTT. Segments whose text is empty after stripping are skipped and SRT cues renumbered accordingly.
- `base/serving.py`: new `TIMESTAMPED_FORMATS = {"verbose_json", "srt", "vtt"}` constant routes srt/vtt through the existing verbose_json prompt preprocessing, logprobs and token-to-segment extraction; the rendered subtitle track is carried in the `text` field of the existing non-verbose response models (with `usage` for transcription, matching the plain `json` path).
- Both API routers return `PlainTextResponse` for `text`/`srt`/`vtt`, as the OpenAI API returns these formats as plain text rather than JSON.
- Docs updated in `docs/serving/online_serving/speech_to_text.md`.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [ ] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Unit tests for SRT/VTT subtitle rendering of speech-to-text segments."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from vllm.entrypoints.speech_to_text.base.utils import (
+    format_segments_as_srt,
+    format_segments_as_vtt,
+)
+
+
+def _segment(start: float, end: float, text: str) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    return SimpleNamespace(start=start, end=end, text=text)
+
+
+def test_srt_basic():
+    segments = [
+        _segment(0.0, 2.5, " Hello, this is a transcription"),
+        _segment(2.5, 5.42, "of the audio file."),
+    ]
+    assert format_segments_as_srt(segments) == (
+        "1\n"
+        "00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:02,500\n"
+        "Hello, this is a transcription\n"
+        "\n"
+        "2\n"
+        "00:00:02,500 --> 00:00:05,420\n"
+        "of the audio file.\n"
+    )
+
+
+def test_vtt_basic():
+    segments = [
+        _segment(0.0, 2.5, "Hello, this is a transcription"),
+        _segment(2.5, 5.42, "of the audio file."),
+    ]
+    assert format_segments_as_vtt(segments) == (
+        "WEBVTT\n"
+        "\n"
+        "00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:02.500\n"
+        "Hello, this is a transcription\n"
+        "\n"
+        "00:00:02.500 --> 00:00:05.420\n"
+        "of the audio file.\n"
+    )
+
+
+def test_timestamp_rollover_to_hours():
+    segments = [_segment(3671.5, 7322.25, "long audio")]
+    assert format_segments_as_srt(segments) == (
+        "1\n01:01:11,500 --> 02:02:02,250\nlong audio\n"
+    )
+    assert format_segments_as_vtt(segments) == (
+        "WEBVTT\n\n01:01:11.500 --> 02:02:02.250\nlong audio\n"
+    )
+
+
+def test_empty_text_segments_are_skipped_and_renumbered():
+    segments = [
+        _segment(0.0, 1.0, "hello"),
+        _segment(1.0, 2.0, "   "),
+        _segment(2.0, 3.0, "world"),
+    ]
+    assert format_segments_as_srt(segments) == (
+        "1\n00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:01,000\nhello\n"
+        "\n"
+        "2\n00:00:02,000 --> 00:00:03,000\nworld\n"
+    )
+
+
+def test_no_segments():
+    assert format_segments_as_srt([]) == ""
+    assert format_segments_as_vtt([]) == "WEBVTT\n"
+
+
+def test_zero_length_segment():
+    segments = [_segment(0.0, 0.0, "x")]
+    assert format_segments_as_srt(segments) == ("1\n00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:00,000\nx\n")

 # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
 """Shared utilities for speech-to-text API routes."""
 
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from typing import Protocol
+
 from fastapi import UploadFile
 
 import vllm.envs as envs
@@ -63,3 +66,67 @@ async def read_upload_with_limit(
         chunks.append(chunk)
 
     return b"".join(chunks)
+
+
+class SubtitleSegment(Protocol):
+    """Structural type for a timestamped speech-to-text segment."""
+
+    start: float
+    end: float
+    text: str
+
+
+def _format_timestamp(seconds: float, decimal_separator: str) -> str:
+    """Format a time in seconds as an ``HH:MM:SS<sep>mmm`` subtitle stamp."""
+    milliseconds = max(0, round(seconds * 1000))
+    hours, milliseconds = divmod(milliseconds, 3_600_000)
+    minutes, milliseconds = divmod(milliseconds, 60_000)
+    secs, milliseconds = divmod(milliseconds, 1_000)
+    return f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}:{secs:02d}{decimal_separator}{milliseconds:03d}"
+
+
+def format_segments_as_srt(segments: Sequence[SubtitleSegment]) -> str:
+    """Render timestamped segments as an SRT subtitle track.
+
+    Follows the shape returned by the OpenAI transcription API for
+    ``response_format="srt"``: one numbered cue per segment with
+    ``HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm`` timestamps and a blank line between
+    cues. Segments whose text is empty after stripping are skipped and the
+    remaining cues are renumbered accordingly.
+    """
+    cues = []
+    for seg in segments:
+        text = seg.text.strip()
+        if not text:
+            continue
+        cues.append(
+            f"{len(cues) + 1}\n"
+            f"{_format_timestamp(seg.start, ',')} --> "
+            f"{_format_timestamp(seg.end, ',')}\n"
+            f"{text}\n"
+        )
+    return "\n".join(cues)
+
+
+def format_segments_as_vtt(segments: Sequence[SubtitleSegment]) -> str:
+    """Render timestamped segments as a WebVTT subtitle track.
+
+    Follows the shape returned by the OpenAI transcription API for
+    ``response_format="vtt"``: a ``WEBVTT`` header followed by unnumbered
+    cues with ``HH:MM:SS.mmm --> HH:MM:SS.mmm`` timestamps and a blank
+    line between cues. Segments whose text is empty after stripping are
+    skipped.
+    """
+    cues = []
+    for seg in segments:
+        text = seg.text.strip()
+        if not text:
+            continue
+        cues.append(
+            f"{_format_timestamp(seg.start, '.')} --> "
+            f"{_format_timestamp(seg.end, '.')}\n"
+            f"{text}\n"
+        )
+    if not cues:
+        return "WEBVTT\n"
+    return "WEBVTT\n\n" + "\n".join(cues)
